script_text: Stop, Aries—the sky is activating your 6th-to-12th House axis today. Mars, ruler of your fire sign, is forming a conjunction with Jupiter at 19° Virgo; both are opposing 19° Aries, intensifying work, support, and hidden-power negotiations. The fire builds urgency, but Jupiter also inflates promises, so precision matters more than force. In the 7th House, a partner may press for definition, while a single Aries is likely to attract someone bold, direct, and financially focused. Do not confuse a dramatic entrance—or a crisis conversation disguised as chemistry—with consistent follow-through. Your 6th House is active: ask for higher pay, streamline a task, or improve a daily workflow, and document each term before agreeing today with both client and boss. Avoid spending to soothe anxiety; the 12th-House opposition can turn an impulsive purchase into overnight regret. Follow for tomorrow’s detailed Mars transit reading.
